cases.title: Broker config, encrypted references, and migrations hold their constraints
cases.expectedResult: references and fingerprints round-trip only under matching keys and matching installation, binding, and generation

cases.title: 1Password adapter exposes no secret-bearing return type
cases.expectedResult: resolved values never appear in adapter output, thrown errors, or logs

cases.title: Broker authorization order and idempotent replay hold under race and crash

cases.title: Hanoon credential projection tables enforce migration order and bounds

cases.title: mTLS client and readiness policy fail closed

cases.title: The three read-only access tools match the trust-kernel manifest exactly
cases.expectedResult: list, status, and verify parameter schemas admit no endpoint, reference, or provider argument

cases.title: No persistence or output surface carries injected canary material
cases.expectedResult: zero canary matches across plugin and broker databases, logs, tool results, and test artifacts

cases.title: Real TLS 1.3 listener enforces client-certificate authentication
cases.expectedResult: untrusted, wrong-fingerprint, and non-POST or wrong-path requests are rejected without a diagnostic body

cases.title: Local Unix admin socket accepts only the fixed enrollment operations
cases.expectedResult: a TCP connection and an unknown operation are refused; every accepted mutation appends one admin event
